import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {

    val config = mapper.readValue("{\"language\":\"php\"}", ProcessConfig::class.java)
    val result = TreeSitterLanguagePack.process("<?php echo 'hello'; ?>", config)
    println(result)
